title: identity-key
description: A cryptographic keypair. The identity-key schema validates the keypair-as-named-pair; the public component's binding to an entity is the identity-record schema.

private-key-location.description: Filesystem path or HSM reference for the private key at the holder's host. Never the private key bytes themselves.

fingerprint.description: Canonical-form hash of the public-key-bytes — same value as the identity-record's id.
